lines.en: It isn’t much longer before I realize where we’re going.
It’s cause for concern, sure. But at the same time...maybe this is a good thing?
Assuming I’m right, that is. Which I very rarely am.
But I have seen this sky before under different, often better circumstances. And while the irony that I’d find it the moment I stop looking is undoubtedly comical, it’s also kind of sad.
I wonder if any of the others have realized it yet.
I wonder what Ayane will do when she finds out her ultimate slumber party may not be happening for quite some time.
But the most wild thing I wonder is why something so conceptually terrifying suddenly puts my mind at ease.
I was nervous just before — not even thirty minutes ago. Could that have only been the case because of where I was and not what loomed overhead?
Maybe that’s why Maya, as small as she was, always managed to stand so tall during times like these. They were one of the only things that ever really stayed the same.
I’ll surely become her at this rate if I do not disappear— destined to chase something I’ll likely never reach.
If what her shadow said earlier truly bore any hope-
If she really is finally willing to hear my tragic tale of the girl she was before the girl she turned back into, wouldn’t it have been better to chase after her earlier?
I know what it’s like to be scared. Which is...probably why I didn’t run her down earlier, now that I think about it.
I probably just didn’t want to see her like that. Mirrors have been hard enough to face lately, and we all look the same when we lose what matters most.
Wherever she is, I hope she can see this.
And I hope it brings back both horrible and joyous memories.
But for now, I’ll have to share the sights with a girl who surely cannot comprehend them.
And maybe that’s why she brought me here.
: If you’re telling me to thank him, no. It’s messed up that he’d just go back to communicating with me when I least need him to. He could have translated earlier.
It’s who it always is — my daughter. Which means she’s either finally on the way to the party or has just made it there and isn’t able to find me.
Either that or she’s lost again. In more ways than one, I’m sure.
But while that would normally worry me, I feel nothing now.
Because I know everything will go back to normal before we know it.
I dismiss the call and retreat to a familiar sight — a new wallpaper, gifted to me by a close friend.
But it’s upon viewing said wallpaper that those fears I was so sure were gone just a second ago begin to crawl back toward me.
: I don’t need to talk to her right now.
: Should you even be worried about that, Nao? You took me here for a reason, didn’t you?
: And I’m sure that reason isn’t just wanting to enroll at Kumon-mi High. Which is good because there’s no way you’re old enough to go there unless you really are an ancient monster.
: Yes, you — the girl who appeared out of nowhere and bears the eyes of the two most important girls in the world to me.
: It makes me want to pet you.
: If that’s supposed to mean something-
: Oh, okay. I guess I’m following you again.
Nao runs off toward the soccer field, as if I hadn’t already gotten my daily dose of nostalgia from returning to the one place I’ve spent almost as much time in as my home.
But the nostalgia I speak of isn’t in relation to Miku. At least not...entirely.
But somehow, sometime...I feel like I have seen this before.
I just can’t put my finger on when.
: I really hope you didn’t take me all the way here to show me your mug collection.
I let out an audible sigh before-
I just don’t know what it is.
She stares at me as if I know what to do.
: What’s going to happen when I get inside?
While I can’t make out her words or thoughts, her mannerisms calm me. But I think she might just be a special type of spider.
The kind that relies not on placing her web in a place where those in search of sustenance may land, but the type who lures her prey back home.
What this means, though, is that I will be spared from her alleged proboscis and feel her fangs instead.
: This is why you brought me here, right? So I can see what’s inside of the doll house?
Her gaze tells me this is no doll house at all.
PLEASE BE ADVISED: PROCEEDING ANY FURTHER MAY-
PLEASE WAIT UNTIL THE ENTIRE WARNING MESSAGES PLAYS BEFORE
: I don’t care what the warning is. I don’t care what happens to me. I don’t care about anything.
YOU ARE NOW BEING MOVED TO TERMINAL 22.
: If we’re going to be thinking up names for our-
: Woah! Where did Yuu go? And who the hell are you?
: I have pepper spray, you know. And any second, my boyfriend will be back to kick your ass if you so much as think of-
: I’m...not going to do anything to you, don’t worry. I don’t even really...know where I am right now.
: So you sneak up on a girl in the middle of the night? Didn’t even want to...think about announcing your presence first?
: I walked into a miniature house and got teleported here.
: Really? Because it sounds like you’re on drugs.
: I’m not on drugs. I promise.
: So what? Are you just looking for the way back to town? Just follow those stairs on your left and-
: Sorry, but what does that have to do with your drug-addled desire to find your way home exactly?
: Just...I knew somebody by that name and...
: This just seems like too big of a coincidence to mean absolutely nothing.
: But hey, at least you can take solace in the fact that I probably won’t remember any of this when I do leave.
: No, you don’t have to apologize. My boyfriend’s weird too. I’m used to dealing with your type.
: And, I’m sorry to be the bearer of bad news, but I highly doubt the person you’re thinking of is the same one I am.
: How can you know that for sure, though?
: Because the one I’m thinking of doesn’t exist.
: My boyfriend and I came out here to collect water and brainstorm baby names. But I guess that weirdo got all delusional and ran off again. He does that some-
: I know you probably won’t listen to me on account of me being some random guy who approached you in the dark and tried to get you to rethink one of the biggest decisions of your life-
: But that name just...isn’t good. It’s too...big.
: No one...would ever be able to live up to it, or...something like that.
: Well, now I’m feeling more inclined to choose that name just to prove you wrong.
: No, let me tell you something. You don’t understand whatever it is you’re trying to say right now.
: You’re just one more stupid adult who’s here to try and tell me that I’m in over my head, but you’re wrong.
: Did the principal put you up to this? One of Yuu’s relatives maybe? Come to think of it, you do look like him. And if that’s the case-
: No, even if that’s not the case, you have no right to tell me how to live my life. None of you do. But you keep trying anyway. Why?
: Yuu isn’t crazy. He’s just a little...off. But I love him. And we’re going to raise the most beautiful, talented child in the world together. Just you wait and see.
: Now, is there anything else? Or do I need to get the pepper spray out after all?
: Do you know a...Saki, by any chance?
: So that’s how it is, huh?
: She’s such a sore loser that she had to send someone out here in the middle of the night to try and intimidate me?
: How much is she paying you? I’ll pay double, no- triple for you to make her back off. Because this is seriously getting tiring.
: The only reason I haven’t filed a restraining order yet is for Yuu’s sake. But there are three of us now, and I just can’t let this happen anymore.
: I think...there’s a bit of a misunderstanding here. Another...name overlap maybe?
: You better hope so...because if I find out that she has anything to do with this, I’m pressing charges against both of you.
: Now, get out of here. I have to find my weirdo boyfriend and make him carry the water.
: Wait. Your name. I still don’t-
: My name is “Leave me alone.” Now beat it or I’ll have you trespassed. This is private property.
: Oh, Miu. There you are. I just remembered- woah. Who is that?
I return to where I’m meant to be and-
I can vaguely recall the smell of a lake.
Is that where I went when I walked through the door?
Was there even a door at all? Because it’s gone now and-
: I wasn’t looking for anything, Nao.
: Why is it that almost every time I’m with you, something inexplicable happens?
: What aren’t you telling me? Because you clearly know more than you let on. And I’m not going to keep disregarding it just because you’re cute. You-
: You have no reason to want that. And even if you do, that doesn’t explain how you can just...retrace the steps of someone else for the sole purpose of fucking with my head.
: How did you send me to...to wherever I just was and...why does it all seem so foggy even though it just happened?
: How do you keep making reality seem even less real than it already does? Are you aware of the way time moves here? Are you part of it? I need answers.
: Nao, how could I believe you? You show up uninvited, whisk me away to places I don’t want to be, coerce blackouts out of me and-
: I don’t know how else to put it.
: Just take me back to the party.
: Or, you know what? Fuck it. I can walk.
: You probably shouldn’t stick around here for much longer, though. Something might happen tonight and-
She points up at the roof.
It was never going to be anywhere else.
But I’m sure that who I find up there won’t be Kaori at all.
It’ll be the ghost inside of her body — the one that crawls into my bed at night.
The one who throws herself at me in death, corrupting the innocent even after she has perished.
I scorn whoever it was that brought her into this world...and I abhor whoever it was that removed her. But I thank them both as well.
For if it were not for them and not for her, I’d never be at all.
I’d be little more than a thought...an unnamed, unwanted baby, losing breath by the second and clawing its way out of the womb.
And it would not matter which hands are there to hold me for what is intangible can never be carried.
Let the ones who can’t have the better half of my life.
